_comment: The tower in climbs (the owner, 2026-11-28; docs/gameplay/27_ATTACK_MOMENT_AND_TOWER_RUN.md §3, §6). on: the main screen after the title, one
climb a chapter (false: the old single run). stamina: max, everySec (one point back each), perFight (Q137: 1); its file is stamina.json in the
save folder (points now, the next point's time). death: the share of the climb's gold and crystals kept (Q134, Q143). score: points per floor,
monster, combo step, perfect (a dodge or parry in a monster's attack beat), minus per damage point and second (Q139); ranks: best first, each
with its crystals. stories: the main screen's list; a story's chapters are story/chapters/<id>.json in order (each opens when the one before is
cleared); a challenge story's chapters climb another chapter's floors (floors) with stronger monsters (hpX, atkX), more gold (goldX) and
crystals when cleared (Q136, Q140: one after each story chapter, its floors fixed).
